profile: Independent CPU/source review of order stand-down and runtime rubble repairs
nativeResolutionMeaning: No raster target; absence marker only.
scoreMeaning: Schema-required unscored sentinel, not product quality.
blindComparison: Not performed. Source-labelled CPU behavior and geometry controls cannot judge an unlabelled stranger preference or establish any product/element quality verdict.
scope: New stand-down, neutral perception/call exclusion, save and autosave, runtime rubble dispatch/default compatibility/removal, and actual Player climb segment. Full City/Enemy/AI/Actor/Combat/Player/Director/Storage code; appearance/output devices and input acquisition are stubs. No perception or Player movement mocks.

findings.problem: A valid save captured after the order interaction but before the next Director poll has trench_talked=true, trench_passed=false and cinderline step 1. After applySave, calling reenterActiveSteps twice grows the neutral Enemy count from 3 to 6 to 9. The previously reviewed Director holds 3,3,3 in the same counterfactual setup.
findings.why: The active-step hook violates the requested repeated-spawn idempotence in the accepted-but-not-polled save state. Multiple neutral bodies can be created; normal single applySave resets the world first and is not claimed to duplicate by itself.
findings.fix: Make accepted pre-poll reentry idempotent before the later passage poll: keep neutral Enemy count constant across repeated active-step entry, whether accepted actors are retained or omitted. Run a fresh-named r2-probe-02 and inspect accepted-prepoll-save-repeated-reentry.cases[current].counts for a constant sequence; preserve next-poll progression. The number to inspect is max(counts)-min(counts), required 0, rather than the current 6. Counts can be read with node -p "JSON.stringify(require('./trench-perception-r2-refuter-probe-01.json').checks[0].result.cases.map(c=>({label:c.label,counts:c.counts})))"; use a new evidence filename for a repaired run.
findings.hypothesis: Confirmed source mechanism: spawnTrenchLine spawns because trench_passed is still false, then _standDownTrench clears _raidActive. The next identical onEnter no longer sees a live raid guard and spawns another neutral group. The previous Director retained _raidActive across repeats.
findings.refutationStatus: survived separate refutation with actual unmodified poll timer; ordinary repeated applySave negative control remains constant

verifiedControls: A real AI Warden swing just before its active frame is canceled by normal input handoff in the same tick; attack, token, target and camera lock clear; no Warden damage occurs during the following 8-second dialogue interval.

Neutral line members do not reacquire the player or join an actual unrelated Warden call; nearby hostile positive control is alerted. A player-faction control is excluded. Scav still flees actual authored gas.

A topic-only lifecycle control reads all order lines through the actual UI callback to PLAY and takes no Warden damage for eight further seconds. With finale quest omitted, actual 90-second autosave succeeds after explicit clear-air relocation; this is not a normal post-ending PLAY claim.
Three deterministic legacy rubble calls match every geometry array and next RNG value against original c65853f props when the new options are omitted.
Runtime plant/rubble removal restores the prior collision count, center support and lights; removed collider IDs are absent from actual collision queries.

Separate refuter reproduced a real Warden damage hit without handing over the order, then reproduced zero Warden damage for eight seconds when the imminent attack was canceled through normal interaction. This is a working damage-path negative control.

Normal cinderline final dialogue stays free of Warden damage for eight seconds, then actual callbacks and the available leave choice produce CINEMATIC with a completed save; eight further seconds also have zero Warden damage. Fully passed step-2 save/applySave, repeated active-step entry and repeated spawn hook retain zero enemies.

Actual quest oblique heap route starts on supported pitwall y=0.9 at (96,16), reaches grounded (90.015291,2.6,16.415701) in 2.383333 seconds using only real Player input and two auto-vaults, and advances step 1 to step 2 with trench_slipped/trench_passed and no trench_talked. The fixture only establishes this final traversal segment, not a complete approach from an earlier chapter.

observations.detail: Normal interaction selection from a chapter-5 CPU setup with countItem(trenchOrder)=0 still grants all passage flags/step2 and neutralizes the line. requiresItem is authored but unused. Full authored chapter progression reachability without that item is unmeasured; do not assert a newly introduced gameplay exploit or require repair on that basis alone. Source control also shows office chapter-3 progression requires collecting trenchOrder, which is a key item. No full normal no-order journey has been demonstrated.

Six center-directed approaches fail to climb. Real landing-overlap rejection explains the sampled direct directions, but oblique landings succeed, so no universal impassability or mandatory geometry redesign is claimed.

rejectedFindings.originalClaim: The failed direct approaches were treated as evidence that the repaired heap had not met the playable climb target.
rejectedFindings.correction: Three oblique input routes reach actual grounded height 2.6 m through two auto-vaults. One route repeated with the actual trench quest also sets trench_slipped and trench_passed and advances to step 2. The broad repair-unmet implication is false; direct-route failures remain bounded observations.

successfulClimb.input: Normal magnitude-1 movement toward each target, no sprint; camera yaw stays zero in the fixture.
phaseTransitions: Distance to first target below 0.14 m
Grounded, not vaulting, and y above 1.9 m
successfulClimb.scope: One supported setup. All later displacement and Y changes come from actual Player physics/vaulting driven only by normal Game input. Waypoint switches use position or grounded height feedback; no obstacle/AI edits and no later position assignment.

retention: All previous drafts, failed approaches, failed earlier-round probes and source-mismatch runs are retained. This final review removes the disproved implication rather than overwriting evidence.
